verses.original: וַיִּתְחַתֵּ֣ן שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה אֶת־ פַּרְעֹ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרָ֑יִם וַיִּקַּ֣ח אֶת־ בַּת־ פַּרְעֹ֗ה וַיְבִיאֶ֙הָ֙ אֶל־ עִ֣יר דָּוִ֔ד עַ֣ד כַּלֹּת֗וֹ לִבְנ֤וֹת אֶת־ בֵּיתוֹ֙ וְאֶת־ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וְאֶת־ חוֹמַ֥ת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם סָבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṯ·ḥat·tên šə·lō·mōh ’eṯ- par·‘ōh me·leḵ miṣ·rā·yim way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- baṯ- par·‘ōh way·ḇî·’e·hā ’el- ‘îr dā·wiḏ ‘aḏ kal·lō·ṯōw liḇ·nō·wṯ ’eṯ- bê·ṯōw wə·’eṯ- bêṯ Yah·weh wə·’eṯ- ḥō·w·maṯ yə·rū·šā·lim sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: Later, Solomon formed an alliance with Pharaoh king of Egypt by marrying his daughter Solomon brought her to the City of David until he had finished building his palace and the house of the LORD as well as the wall around Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Salomão aparentou-se com Faraó, rei do Egito, pois tomou por mulher a filha de Faraó e a levou para a Cidade de Davi, até que acabasse de edificar a sua casa, e a Casa de Jeová, e o muro à roda de Jerusalém.

verses.original: רַ֣ק הָעָ֔ם מְזַבְּחִ֖ים בַּבָּמ֑וֹת כִּ֠י לֹא־ נִבְנָ֥ה בַ֙יִת֙ לְשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה עַ֖ד הַיָּמִ֥ים הָהֵֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: raq hā·‘ām mə·zab·bə·ḥîm bab·bā·mō·wṯ kî lō- niḇ·nāh ḇa·yiṯ lə·šêm Yah·weh ‘aḏ hay·yā·mîm hā·hêm
verses.literal: The people however were still sacrificing on the high places because a house for the Name of the LORD had not yet . . . . . . been built
verses.literalPt: Entretanto, o povo oferecia sacrifícios sobre os altos, porque, até aqueles dias, não se tinha edificado casa ao nome de Jeová.

verses.original: וַיֶּאֱהַ֤ב שְׁלֹמֹה֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה לָלֶ֕כֶת בְּחֻקּ֖וֹת דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֑יו רַ֚ק בַּבָּמ֔וֹת ה֥וּא מְזַבֵּ֖חַ וּמַקְטִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ye·’ĕ·haḇ šə·lō·mōh ’eṯ- Yah·weh lā·le·ḵeṯ bə·ḥuq·qō·wṯ dā·wiḏ ’ā·ḇîw raq bab·bā·mō·wṯ hū mə·zab·bê·aḥ ū·maq·ṭîr
verses.literal: And Solomon loved the LORD and walked in the statutes of his father David except that he sacrificed and burned incense on the high places
verses.literalPt: Salomão amava a Jeová, andando nos estatutos de seu pai Davi, exceto que ele oferecia sacrifícios e queimava incenso nos altos.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֨לֶךְ הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ גִּבְעֹ֙נָה֙ לִזְבֹּ֣חַ שָׁ֔ם כִּ֥י הִ֖יא הַבָּמָ֣ה הַגְּדוֹלָ֑ה אֶ֤לֶף עֹלוֹת֙ יַעֲלֶ֣ה שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה עַ֖ל הַמִּזְבֵּ֥חַ הַהֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ ham·me·leḵ giḇ·‘ō·nāh liz·bō·aḥ šām kî hî hab·bā·māh hag·gə·ḏō·w·lāh ’e·lep̄ ‘ō·lō·wṯ ya·‘ă·leh šə·lō·mōh ‘al ham·miz·bê·aḥ ha·hū
verses.literal: Now the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there for it was the great high place Solomon offered a thousand burnt offerings on the altar there
verses.literalPt: Foi o rei a Gibeão, para oferecer sacrifícios, porque aquele era o grande alto. Ofereceu Salomão mil holocaustos sobre aquele altar.

verses.original: בְּגִבְע֗וֹן נִרְאָ֧ה יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶל־ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה בַּחֲל֣וֹם הַלָּ֑יְלָה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֔ים שְׁאַ֖ל מָ֥ה אֶתֶּן־ לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḡiḇ·‘ō·wn nir·’āh Yah·weh ’el- šə·lō·mōh ba·ḥă·lō·wm hal·lā·yə·lāh way·yō·mer ’ĕ·lō·hîm šə·’al māh ’et·ten- lāḵ
verses.literal: One night at Gibeon the LORD appeared to Solomon in a dream and God said Ask and I will give it to you
verses.literalPt: Em Gibeão, apareceu Jeová a Salomão, em sonho de noite. Disse-lhe Deus: Pede-me o que queres que eu te dê.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה אַתָּ֨ה עָשִׂ֜יתָ עִם־ עַבְדְּךָ֙ דָוִ֣ד אָבִי֮ חֶ֣סֶד גָּדוֹל֒ כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ הָלַ֨ךְ לְפָנֶ֜יךָ בֶּאֱמֶ֧ת וּבִצְדָקָ֛ה וּבְיִשְׁרַ֥ת לֵבָ֖ב עִמָּ֑ךְ וַתִּשְׁמָר־ ל֗וֹ אֶת־ הַחֶ֤סֶד הַגָּדוֹל֙ הַזֶּ֔ה וַתִּתֶּן־ ל֥וֹ בֵ֛ן יֹשֵׁ֥ב עַל־ כִּסְא֖וֹ כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šə·lō·mōh ’at·tāh ‘ā·śî·ṯā ‘im- ‘aḇ·də·ḵā ḏā·wiḏ ’ā·ḇî ḥe·seḏ gā·ḏō·wl ka·’ă·šer hā·laḵ lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā be·’ĕ·meṯ ū·ḇiṣ·ḏā·qāh ū·ḇə·yiš·raṯ lê·ḇāḇ ‘im·māḵ wat·tiš·mār- lōw ’eṯ- ha·ḥe·seḏ hag·gā·ḏō·wl haz·zeh wat·tit·ten- lōw ḇên yō·šêḇ ‘al- kis·’ōw kay·yō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: Solomon replied You have shown much loving devotion to Your servant my father David because he walked before You in faithfulness righteousness and uprightness of heart . . . And You have maintained this loving devotion by giving him a son to sit on his throne this very day
verses.literalPt: Respondeu Salomão: Tu usaste de grande misericórdia com meu pai Davi, teu servo, segundo ele andou diante de ti em verdade, e justiça, e em retidão de coração para contigo; guardaste-lhe esta grande misericórdia deste-lhe um filho que se assentasse no seu trono, como hoje está.

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔י אַתָּה֙ הִמְלַ֣כְתָּ אֶֽת־ עַבְדְּךָ֔ תַּ֖חַת דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֑י וְאָֽנֹכִי֙ נַ֣עַר קָטֹ֔ן לֹ֥א אֵדַ֖ע צֵ֥את וָבֹֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāy ’at·tāh him·laḵ·tā ’eṯ- ‘aḇ·də·ḵā ta·ḥaṯ dā·wiḏ ’ā·ḇî wə·’ā·nō·ḵî na·‘ar qā·ṭōn lō ’ê·ḏa‘ ṣêṯ wā·ḇō
verses.literal: And now O LORD my God You have made Your servant king in my father David’s place But I am only a little child not knowing how to go out or come in
verses.literalPt: Agora, ó Jeová, meu Deus, tu me fizeste reinar a mim em lugar de Davi, meu pai. Eu sou um menino pequenino; não sei sair, nem entrar.

verses.original: וְעַ֨בְדְּךָ֔ בְּת֥וֹךְ עַמְּךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּחָ֑רְתָּ עַם־ רָ֕ב אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא־ יִמָּנֶ֛ה וְלֹ֥א יִסָּפֵ֖ר מֵרֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘aḇ·də·ḵā bə·ṯō·wḵ ‘am·mə·ḵā ’ă·šer bā·ḥā·rə·tā ‘am- rāḇ ’ă·šer lō- yim·mā·neh wə·lō yis·sā·p̄êr mê·rōḇ
verses.literal: Your servant is here among the people You have chosen a people . . . - too numerous to count . . . or number
verses.literalPt: Teu servo está no meio de teu povo que escolheste, dum povo grande que nem se pode contar, nem reduzir a número pela multidão.

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֨ לְעַבְדְּךָ֜ לֵ֤ב שֹׁמֵ֙עַ֙ לִשְׁפֹּ֣ט אֶֽת־ עַמְּךָ֔ לְהָבִ֖ין בֵּֽין־ ט֣וֹב לְרָ֑ע כִּ֣י מִ֤י יוּכַל֙ לִשְׁפֹּ֔ט אֶת־ עַמְּךָ֥ הַכָּבֵ֖ד הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯa·tā lə·‘aḇ·də·ḵā lêḇ šō·mê·a‘ liš·pōṭ ’eṯ- ‘am·mə·ḵā lə·hā·ḇîn bên- ṭō·wḇ lə·rā‘ kî mî yū·ḵal liš·pōṭ ’eṯ- ‘am·mə·ḵā hak·kā·ḇêḏ haz·zeh
verses.literal: Therefore give Your servant an understanding heart to judge Your people and to discern between good and evil For who is able to govern this great people of Yours
verses.literalPt: Dá, pois, ao teu servo um coração dócil para poder julgar ao teu povo e para poder discernir entre o bem e o mal. Por que quem poderá julgar a este teu povo tão grande?

verses.original: וַיִּיטַ֥ב הַדָּבָ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֣י אֲדֹנָ֑י כִּ֚י שָׁאַ֣ל שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֖ר הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yî·ṭaḇ had·dā·ḇār bə·‘ê·nê ’ă·ḏō·nāy kî šā·’al šə·lō·mōh ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh
verses.literal: Now it pleased . . . the Lord that Solomon - had made this request . . .
verses.literalPt: Agradou ao Senhor essa oração, por ter Salomão pedido uma tal coisa.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֜ים אֵלָ֗יו יַעַן֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר שָׁאַ֜לְתָּ אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֗ה וְלֹֽא־ שָׁאַ֨לְתָּ לְּךָ֜ יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֗ים וְלֹֽא־ שָׁאַ֤לְתָּ לְּךָ֙ עֹ֔שֶׁר וְלֹ֥א שָׁאַ֖לְתָּ נֶ֣פֶשׁ אֹיְבֶ֑יךָ וְשָׁאַ֧לְתָּ לְּךָ֛ הָבִ֖ין לִשְׁמֹ֥עַ מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ê·lāw ya·‘an ’ă·šer šā·’al·tā ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh wə·lō- šā·’al·tā lə·ḵā yā·mîm rab·bîm wə·lō- šā·’al·tā lə·ḵā ‘ō·šer wə·lō šā·’al·tā ne·p̄eš ’ō·yə·ḇe·ḵā wə·šā·’al·tā lə·ḵā hā·ḇîn liš·mō·a‘ miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: So God said to him Since you have asked for - this instead of requesting long life or wealth for yourself or . . . death for your enemies but you have asked for discernment to administer justice
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe Deus: Porquanto pediste essa coisa e não pediste muitos dias, nem riquezas, nem a vida dos teus inimigos, porém pediste entendimento para discernires o que é justo,

verses.original: הִנֵּ֥ה עָשִׂ֖יתִי כִּדְבָרֶ֑יךָ הִנֵּ֣ה׀ נָתַ֣תִּי לְךָ֗ לֵ֚ב חָכָ֣ם וְנָב֔וֹן אֲשֶׁ֤ר כָּמ֙וֹךָ֙ לֹא־ הָיָ֣ה לְפָנֶ֔יךָ וְאַחֲרֶ֖יךָ לֹא־ יָק֥וּם כָּמֽוֹךָ׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ‘ā·śî·ṯî kiḏ·ḇā·re·ḵā hin·nêh nā·ṯat·tî lə·ḵā lêḇ ḥā·ḵām wə·nā·ḇō·wn ’ă·šer kā·mō·w·ḵā lō- hā·yāh lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā wə·’a·ḥă·re·ḵā lō- yā·qūm kā·mō·w·ḵā
verses.literal: behold I will do what you have asked . . . I will give you a wise and discerning heart so that there will never have been another like you nor will there ever be
verses.literalPt: eis que faço segundo as tuas palavras. Eis que te dou um coração sábio e entendido, de modo que, antes de ti, não houve quem te fosse semelhante, nem depois de ti se levantará teu igual.

verses.original: וְגַ֨ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־ שָׁאַ֙לְתָּ֙ נָתַ֣תִּי לָ֔ךְ גַּם־ עֹ֖שֶׁר גַּם־ כָּב֑וֹד אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹא־ הָיָ֨ה כָמ֥וֹךָ אִ֛ישׁ בַּמְּלָכִ֖ים כָּל־ יָמֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam ’ă·šer lō- šā·’al·tā nā·ṯat·tî lāḵ gam- ‘ō·šer gam- kā·ḇō·wḏ ’ă·šer lō- hā·yāh ḵā·mō·w·ḵā ’îš bam·mə·lā·ḵîm kāl- yā·me·ḵā
verses.literal: Moreover I will give you what you did not request both riches and honor so that during all your days no man in any kingdom will be your equal
verses.literalPt: Também te dei o que me não pediste, a saber, riquezas e glória, de modo que não haverá nenhum dentre os reis semelhante a ti, por todos os teus dias.

verses.original: וְאִ֣ם׀ תֵּלֵ֣ךְ בִּדְרָכַ֗י לִשְׁמֹ֤ר חֻקַּי֙ וּמִצְוֺתַ֔י כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלַ֖ךְ דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֑יךָ וְהַאַרַכְתִּ֖י אֶת־ יָמֶֽיךָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’im tê·lêḵ biḏ·rā·ḵay liš·mōr ḥuq·qay ū·miṣ·wō·ṯay ka·’ă·šer hā·laḵ dā·wîḏ ’ā·ḇî·ḵā wə·ha·’a·raḵ·tî ’eṯ- yā·me·ḵā
verses.literal: So if you walk in My ways and keep My statutes and commandments just as your father David did I will prolong your days
verses.literalPt: Se tu andares nos meus caminhos, guardando os meus estatutos e os meus mandamentos, como andou teu pai Davi, prolongarei os teus dias.

verses.original: וַיִּקַ֥ץ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה וְהִנֵּ֣ה חֲל֑וֹם וַיָּב֨וֹא יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם וַֽיַּעֲמֹ֣ד׀ לִפְנֵ֣י׀ אֲר֣וֹן בְּרִית־ אֲדֹנָ֗י וַיַּ֤עַל עֹלוֹת֙ וַיַּ֣עַשׂ שְׁלָמִ֔ים וַיַּ֥עַשׂ מִשְׁתֶּ֖ה לְכָל־ עֲבָדָֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yi·qaṣ šə·lō·mōh wə·hin·nêh ḥă·lō·wm way·yā·ḇō·w yə·rū·šā·lim way·ya·‘ă·mōḏ lip̄·nê ’ă·rō·wn bə·rîṯ- ’ă·ḏō·nāy way·ya·‘al ‘ō·lō·wṯ way·ya·‘aś šə·lā·mîm way·ya·‘aś miš·teh lə·ḵāl ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw
verses.literal: Then Solomon awoke and indeed it had been a dream So he returned to Jerusalem stood before the ark of the covenant of the Lord and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings . . . Then he held a feast for all his servants
verses.literalPt: Então, despertou Salomão, e eis que era sonho. Tendo vindo a Jerusalém, pôs-se diante da arca da Aliança do Senhor, ofereceu holocaustos e ofertas pacíficas e deu um banquete a todos os seus servos.

verses.original: אָ֣ז תָּבֹ֗אנָה שְׁתַּ֛יִם נָשִׁ֥ים זֹנ֖וֹת אֶל־ הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַֽתַּעֲמֹ֖דְנָה לְפָנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ’āz tā·ḇō·nāh šə·ta·yim nā·šîm zō·nō·wṯ ’el- ham·me·leḵ wat·ta·‘ă·mō·ḏə·nāh lə·p̄ā·nāw
verses.literal: At that time two prostitutes came to the king and stood before him
verses.literalPt: Vieram ter com o rei duas mulheres prostitutas e puseram-se diante dele.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֜אמֶר הָאִשָּׁ֤ה הָֽאַחַת֙ בִּ֣י אֲדֹנִ֔י אֲנִי֙ וְהָאִשָּׁ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את יֹשְׁבֹ֖ת בְּבַ֣יִת אֶחָ֑ד וָאֵלֵ֥ד עִמָּ֖הּ בַּבָּֽיִת׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer hā·’iš·šāh hā·’a·ḥaṯ bî ’ă·ḏō·nî ’ă·nî wə·hā·’iš·šāh haz·zōṯ yō·šə·ḇōṯ bə·ḇa·yiṯ ’e·ḥāḏ wā·’ê·lêḏ ‘im·māh bab·bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: One woman said Please my lord this woman and I live in the same house and I gave birth while she was in the house
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe uma das mulheres: Ah! Meu senhor! Eu e esta mulher moramos na mesma casa. Dei à luz um filho, estando ela comigo.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֞י בַּיּ֤וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי֙ לְלִדְתִּ֔י וַתֵּ֖לֶד גַּם־ הָאִשָּׁ֣ה הַזֹּ֑את וַאֲנַ֣חְנוּ יַחְדָּ֗ו אֵֽין־ זָ֤ר אִתָּ֙נוּ֙ בַּבַּ֔יִת זוּלָתִ֥י שְׁתַּֽיִם־ אֲנַ֖חְנוּ בַּבָּֽיִת׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bay·yō·wm haš·šə·lî·šî lə·liḏ·tî wat·tê·leḏ gam- hā·’iš·šāh haz·zōṯ wa·’ă·naḥ·nū yaḥ·dāw ’ên- zār ’it·tā·nū bab·ba·yiṯ zū·lā·ṯî šə·ta·yim- ’ă·naḥ·nū bab·bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: On the third day after I gave birth this woman . . . also had a baby We were alone with no one in the house but the two of us . . .
verses.literalPt: Três dias depois de ter eu dado à luz, também esta mulher deu à luz um filho. Nós estávamos juntas; nenhuma outra pessoa estava conosco na casa, somente nós estávamos ali.

verses.original: וַיָּ֛מָת בֶּן־ הָאִשָּׁ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את לָ֑יְלָה אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁכְבָ֖ה עָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māṯ ben- hā·’iš·šāh haz·zōṯ lā·yə·lāh ’ă·šer šā·ḵə·ḇāh ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: During the night this woman’s son died because she rolled over on him
verses.literalPt: Durante a noite, morreu o filho desta mulher, porque se deitara sobre ele.

verses.original: וַתָּקָם֩ בְּת֨וֹךְ הַלַּ֜יְלָה וַתִּקַּ֧ח אֶת־ בְּנִ֣י מֵֽאֶצְלִ֗י וַאֲמָֽתְךָ֙ יְשֵׁנָ֔ה וַתַּשְׁכִּיבֵ֖הוּ בְּחֵיקָ֑הּ וְאֶת־ בְּנָ֥הּ הַמֵּ֖ת הִשְׁכִּ֥יבָה בְחֵיקִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tā·qām bə·ṯō·wḵ hal·lay·lāh wat·tiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- bə·nî mê·’eṣ·lî wa·’ă·mā·ṯə·ḵā yə·šê·nāh wat·taš·kî·ḇê·hū bə·ḥê·qāh wə·’eṯ- bə·nāh ham·mêṯ hiš·kî·ḇāh ḇə·ḥê·qî
verses.literal: So she got up in the middle of the night and took my son from my side while I was asleep She laid him in her bosom and put her dead son at my bosom
verses.literalPt: Levantando-se ela à meia noite, enquanto dormia a tua escrava, tirou-me do lado a meu filho, e deitou-o no seu seio, e a seu filho morto deitou-o no meu seio.

verses.original: וָאָקֻ֥ם בַּבֹּ֛קֶר לְהֵינִ֥יק אֶת־ בְּנִ֖י וְהִנֵּה־ מֵ֑ת וָאֶתְבּוֹנֵ֤ן אֵלָיו֙ בַּבֹּ֔קֶר וְהִנֵּ֛ה לֹֽא־ הָיָ֥ה בְנִ֖י אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָלָֽדְתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ā·qum bab·bō·qer lə·hê·nîq ’eṯ- bə·nî wə·hin·nêh- mêṯ wā·’eṯ·bō·w·nên ’ê·lāw bab·bō·qer wə·hin·nêh lō- hā·yāh ḇə·nî ’ă·šer yā·lā·ḏə·tî
verses.literal: The next morning when I got up to nurse my son I discovered he was dead But when I examined him . . . I realized that he was not the son I had borne
verses.literalPt: Levantando-me eu pela manhã, para dar de mamar a meu filho, eis que estava ele morto; mas, depois de eu o ter examinado de dia, eis que não era ele o filho que me nascera.

verses.original: וַתֹּאמֶר֩ הָאִשָּׁ֨ה הָאַחֶ֜רֶת לֹ֣א כִ֗י בְּנִ֤י הַחַי֙ וּבְנֵ֣ךְ הַמֵּ֔ת וְזֹ֤את אֹמֶ֙רֶת֙ לֹ֣א כִ֔י בְּנֵ֥ךְ הַמֵּ֖ת וּבְנִ֣י הֶחָ֑י וַתְּדַבֵּ֖רְנָה לִפְנֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer hā·’iš·šāh hā·’a·ḥe·reṯ lō ḵî bə·nî ha·ḥay ū·ḇə·nêḵ ham·mêṯ wə·zōṯ ’ō·me·reṯ lō ḵî bə·nêḵ ham·mêṯ ū·ḇə·nî he·ḥāy wat·tə·ḏab·bê·rə·nāh lip̄·nê ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: No . . . said the other woman the living one is my son and the dead one is your son But the first woman insisted No . . . the dead one is yours and the living one is mine So they argued before the king
verses.literalPt: A outra mulher respondeu: Não é assim; mas o vivo é meu filho, e o morto é o teu. A primeira replicou: Não; mas o morto é teu filho, e o vivo é o meu. Assim falavam diante do rei.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ זֹ֣את אֹמֶ֔רֶת זֶה־ בְּנִ֥י הַחַ֖י וּבְנֵ֣ךְ הַמֵּ֑ת וְזֹ֤את אֹמֶ֙רֶת֙ לֹ֣א כִ֔י בְּנֵ֥ךְ הַמֵּ֖ת וּבְנִ֥י הֶחָֽי׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ham·me·leḵ zōṯ ’ō·me·reṯ zeh- bə·nî ha·ḥay ū·ḇə·nêḵ ham·mêṯ wə·zōṯ ’ō·me·reṯ lō ḵî bə·nêḵ ham·mêṯ ū·ḇə·nî he·ḥāy
verses.literal: Then the king replied This woman says My son is alive and yours is dead but that woman says No . . . your son is dead and mine is alive
verses.literalPt: Disse o rei: Esta diz: O que está vivo é meu filho, e o teu é o morto; e a outra responde: Não, mas teu filho é o morto, e o meu é o vivo.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ קְח֣וּ לִי־ חָ֑רֶב וַיָּבִ֥אוּ הַחֶ֖רֶב לִפְנֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ham·me·leḵ qə·ḥū lî- ḥā·reḇ way·yā·ḇi·’ū ha·ḥe·reḇ lip̄·nê ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: The king continued Bring me a sword So they brought him a sword
verses.literalPt: Disse, pois, o rei: Trazei-me uma espada. Trouxeram uma espada diante do rei.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ גִּזְר֛וּ אֶת־ הַיֶּ֥לֶד הַחַ֖י לִשְׁנָ֑יִם וּתְנ֤וּ אֶֽת־ הַחֲצִי֙ לְאַחַ֔ת וְאֶֽת־ הַחֲצִ֖י לְאֶחָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ham·me·leḵ giz·rū ’eṯ- hay·ye·leḏ ha·ḥay liš·nā·yim ū·ṯə·nū ’eṯ- ha·ḥă·ṣî lə·’a·ḥaṯ wə·’eṯ- ha·ḥă·ṣî lə·’e·ḥāṯ
verses.literal: and the king declared Cut the living child in two and give half to one and half to the other
verses.literalPt: Dividi, disse o rei, em duas partes o menino que está vivo e dai metade a uma e metade a outra.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר הָאִשָּׁה֩ אֲשֶׁר־ בְּנָ֨הּ הַחַ֜י אֶל־ הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ כִּֽי־ נִכְמְר֣וּ רַחֲמֶיהָ֮ עַל־ בְּנָהּ֒ וַתֹּ֣אמֶר׀ בִּ֣י אֲדֹנִ֗י תְּנוּ־ לָהּ֙ אֶת־ הַיָּל֣וּד הַחַ֔י וְהָמֵ֖ת אַל־ תְּמִיתֻ֑הוּ וְזֹ֣את אֹמֶ֗רֶת גַּם־ לִ֥י גַם־ לָ֛ךְ לֹ֥א יִהְיֶ֖ה גְּזֹֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer hā·’iš·šāh ’ă·šer- bə·nāh ha·ḥay ’el- ham·me·leḵ kî- niḵ·mə·rū ra·ḥă·me·hā ‘al- bə·nāh wat·tō·mer bî ’ă·ḏō·nî tə·nū- lāh ’eṯ- hay·yā·lūḏ ha·ḥay wə·hā·mêṯ ’al- tə·mî·ṯu·hū wə·zōṯ ’ō·me·reṯ gam- lî ḡam- lāḵ lō yih·yeh gə·zō·rū
verses.literal: Then the woman whose son was alive spoke to the king because she yearned with compassion for her son Please my lord she said give her the living baby Do not kill him But the other woman said He will be neither mine nor yours Cut him in two
verses.literalPt: Então, a mulher de quem era o filho que estava vivo falou ao rei (porque as suas entranhas se lhe enterneceram por seu filho.): Ah! Meu senhor! Dai-lhe a ela o menino que está vivo e de modo nenhum o mateis. A outra, porém, disse: Não será ele nem meu nem teu; dividi-o.

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַן הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר תְּנוּ־ לָהּ֙ אֶת־ הַיָּל֣וּד הַחַ֔י וְהָמֵ֖ת לֹ֣א תְמִיתֻ֑הוּ הִ֖יא אִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an ham·me·leḵ way·yō·mer tə·nū- lāh ’eṯ- hay·yā·lūḏ ha·ḥay wə·hā·mêṯ lō ṯə·mî·ṯu·hū hî ’im·mōw
verses.literal: Then the king gave his ruling . . . Give the living baby to the first woman By no means should you kill him . . . she is his mother
verses.literalPt: Respondeu o rei: Dai a esta o menino vivo e de modo nenhum o mateis; esta é sua mãe.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמְע֣וּ כָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֶת־ הַמִּשְׁפָּט֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁפַ֣ט הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַיִּֽרְא֖וּ מִפְּנֵ֣י הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ כִּ֣י רָא֔וּ כִּֽי־ חָכְמַ֧ת אֱלֹהִ֛ים בְּקִרְבּ֖וֹ לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת מִשְׁפָּֽט׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·mə·‘ū ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- ham·miš·pāṭ ’ă·šer šā·p̄aṭ ham·me·leḵ way·yir·’ū mip·pə·nê ham·me·leḵ kî rā·’ū kî- ḥā·ḵə·maṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm bə·qir·bōw la·‘ă·śō·wṯ miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: When all Israel heard of the judgment the king had given they stood in awe of him for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him to administer justice
verses.literalPt: Todo o Israel ouviu a sentença que o rei havia proferido; tiveram medo do rei, porque viram que estava nele a sabedoria de Deus, para fazer justiça.
